payload.name: Preserve Distinct Concrete Functions in Extraction
payload.description: When extracting memory from a message in which a person says a tool, device, or service has several specific functions, use this to preserve each concrete function explicitly instead of collapsing them into a generic benefit.
content: During extraction, if the source states multiple distinct concrete functions or effects of an object, preserve each as its own explicit clause or candidate; do not replace any specific function with a broader generalization such as 'stay motivated'.

When a directly stated fact (e.g., 'serves as a constant reminder to keep going') is clear, include its specific wording or a faithful close paraphrase in the candidate content, even if another clause summarizes the overall purpose.

solves: When a user states that a tool, device, or service provides several distinct concrete functions (e.g., tracks progress, serves as a reminder, gives alerts), extraction candidates sometimes replace one specific function with a broader generalization, losing answerable facts. The fix is to preserve each explicit concrete function rather than collapsing it into an umbrella term like motivation.
